name: Rivermate
summary: Rivermate employs people in 180+ countries through 38 entities it owns plus partner entities. Employer of record starts at $349 per employee per month with no onboarding or offboarding costs, and the price varies by country, headcount and whether the hire is an expat.

evidence.capability: employment in countries without an entity

facts.text: Rivermate says it uses its own entities and partner entities, and that it owns 38 entities.
Rivermate uses a network of local providers for healthcare and dental benefits.
Rivermate says it is GDPR compliant, and notes that its AWS hosting is SOC 2 Type II and ISO/IEC 27001 compliant, which is not a certification of Rivermate itself.

plans.name: Employer of Record
plans.notes: Starting price. Varies by country, headcount, project and expat versus local hire. No onboarding or offboarding costs

hiddenCosts: Global health insurance is optional and its price is not listed.
Billing terms and deposits are not published on the pricing page.
